case: Sunday: "this week" asked on the week's last day is the coming week

answers.text:
During the week the family has Parents' evening on Tuesday, 20 October, Football training on Wednesday, 21 October, Swimming lesson and Piano lesson on Thursday, 22 October, Dinner at Nona Marija's on Friday, 23 October, and an U13 match, Olimpija (Ivy) — Bring white shirt, shin pads & water on Saturday, 24 October.  
Tasks for the week are to practise reading on Monday, 19 October and to sign the school trip form on Tuesday, 20 October.
